name: Henjō
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 12); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 890.

poems.title: Oh stormy winds, bring up the clouds
poems.author: Henjō
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 12
poems.text:
Oh stormy winds, bring up the clouds,
And paint the heavens grey;
Lest these fair maids of form divine
Should angel wings display,
And fly far far away.

poems.title: 12. 天つ風 雲のかよひぢ 吹きとぢよ (Ama tsukaze kumo no kayoiji fukitoji yo)
poems.author: Henjō
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
天つ風 雲のかよひぢ 吹きとぢよ
をとめの姿 しばし留めむ
